definitions.explanation: The rhythmic beating of arteries as blood is pumped through them by the heart. Measured as beats per minute and used as a basic health indicator.

examples.japanese: {脈拍|みゃくはく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{測|はか}る→測る：01977_hakaru⟧。
⟦{運動|うんどう}→運動：00821_undou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{脈拍|みゃくはく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がる→上がる：00615_agaru⟧。
examples.english: Your pulse goes up when you exercise.

examples.japanese: ⟦{看護師|かんごし}→看護師：05055_kangoshi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{患者|かんじゃ}→患者：00170_kanja⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{脈拍|みゃくはく}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{血圧|けつあつ}→血圧：00218_ketsuatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}した→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: The nurse checked the patient's pulse and blood pressure.

notes:
USAGE:
{脈拍|みゃくはく} is the standard medical/formal term for pulse. In casual speech, ⟦{脈|みゃく}→脈：05247_myaku⟧ alone is often sufficient.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {脈拍|みゃくはく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{測|はか}る→測る：01977_hakaru⟧ (to measure one's pulse)
- {脈拍|みゃくはく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{速|はや}い→速い：00514_hayai⟧ / ⟦{遅|おそ}い→遅い：00533_osoi⟧ (pulse is fast / slow)
- {脈拍|みゃくはく}⟦{数|すう}→数：03360_suu⟧ (pulse rate)
- {安静時|あんせいじ}{脈拍|みゃくはく} (resting pulse)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{脈|みゃく}→脈：05247_myaku⟧: pulse — shorter form, used more casually
- ⟦{心拍|しんぱく}→心拍：25482_shinpaku⟧: heartbeat — specifically the beating of the heart itself
- {心拍数|しんぱくすう}: heart rate — numerical measurement
